title: EOS Deep Analysis — Coefficient Problem and Factor-of-2

issue_1_factor_of_2.verdict: File reports a0 = a_gh/(2Z) but analytic deep limit mu=a/a0 gives a0=a_gh/Z. Factor of 2.

issue_2_z_collision.verdict: Different mathematical objects, same symbol name. Catastrophic collision.

issue_4_coefficient.verdict: EOS r=222.4322 matches NONE of 1.0, 12.566370614359172, or framework values.

issue_5_kms.verdict: Orbital motion breaks KMS by ~1e-6 or less. O(1) violation needed to flip sign.

issue_6_memory.verdict: 'Instantaneous' reading is backwards. Kernel decays over ~101 Gyr — SLOW memory.
